region: Telangana, India (Jagtial, Karimnagar, Warangal, Nalgonda agro-climatic zones)
design_rationale: Comprehensive 10-category evaluation distribution reflecting real-world Indian smallholder field conditions, natural sunlight, complex soil backgrounds, variable pest stages, and clinical pathology ambiguity.

anti_leakage_protocol.rule_1_group_split: All photos from the same plant_id and same field plot MUST reside strictly within either train, val, or test split. Never split pictures of the same plant across splits.
anti_leakage_protocol.rule_2_temporal_split: Consecutive burst photographs taken within the same capture_session_id must not bridge train and test.
anti_leakage_protocol.rule_3_background_independence: Test sets must include varied natural field soil, mulching, weeds, and varying diurnal sunlight angles to detect background spurious correlation.

specification_items.diagnostic_note: Foliage vigorous green without necrotic spots. Pipeline must abstain from fabricating any pathogen or issuing chemical spray.
Normal vegetative cotton leaves. System must abstain and indicate healthy foliage.
Classic spindle/diamond shaped lesions with ash-grey center and dark reddish-brown margins.
Angular water-soaked leaf spots bounded by veinlets turning dark purplish brown.
Sunken circular spots with concentric rings of black acervuli on ripe chilli pods.

specification_items.condition_name: Early Rice Blast vs Brown Spot Differential
specification_items.diagnostic_note: Early circular brown necrotic spots where spindle center has not fully elongated. Pipeline must return BOTH blast and brown spot as differential candidates.

specification_items.condition_name: Chilli Murda Complex (Thrips vs Mites vs Gemini Virus)
specification_items.diagnostic_note: Upward cupping (thrips) vs downward inverted cupping (yellow mite). System must provide differential field check instructions.
Rusty-brown coalescing blotches on middle/lower leaves. Must identify micronutrient deficiency and NEVER prescribe antifungal fungicides.
Interveinal purplish-red discoloration while veins remain green on mature bolls stage.
Muddy yellow silt-covered droopy leaves after flooding. Must NOT be misdiagnosed as fungal leaf blight.
Circular patches of dried golden-brown tillers with hopper nymphs feeding at the plant collar.
Rosetted flower buds and entry bore-holes on green cotton bolls.

specification_items.condition_name: Mixed Blast and Sheath Blight Co-Infection
specification_items.diagnostic_note: Leaf blade exhibits blast lesions while leaf collar displays snake-skin sheath blight lesions. Multi-candidate recognition required.
Machine or tool in agricultural shed. Must trigger isPlant: false pre-filter and reject.
Crop not present in validated Telangana PJTAU database. Must gracefully flag unsupported crop and list supported species.
Average luminance < 20. Must be intercepted by Phase B pre-inference quality gate before vision model execution.
